messages.content: Help me validate that the private, package-private, and public inner fields of a `RedefClass` instance `myRedefClass` all have the value 100, and log a complaint if they do not?

function.name: checkInnerFields
function.description: Checks if the inner fields of the given RedefClass instance have the expected value. If not, it sets the test status to failed and logs a complaint. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

redefCls.description: The instance of RedefClass to be checked. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

expValue.description: The expected value for the inner fields. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.
